name: HolonIQ homepage: a landing page for impact market intelligence
title: HolonIQ homepage: a landing page for impact market intelligence
answer: HolonIQ's homepage is a marketing landing page for a platform it describes as impact market intelligence, covering data, research and forecasting on the global impact economy. It offers no article, report or dataset on the page itself. The most useful thing it states is what the platform claims to do: size addressable markets, quantify demand, forecast scenarios at varying growth rates, and support strategic decisions on buying, building or partnering. For education readers it is a pointer to a vendor, not a source of findings.

sections.body: This is the homepage of HolonIQ, a company that presents itself as a platform for impact market intelligence. The harvested text is a commercial landing page rather than a report, article or dataset. It describes the company's stated purpose, which is providing data and proprietary research on what it calls the global impact economy, and it lists the kinds of analysis and support it offers to clients. No publication date is given in the harvested text. The page also invites readers to sign up for newsletters. It contains no education specific section, no named author and no cited research.
sections.heading: What this source is

sections.body: The page presents HolonIQ as a platform for impact market intelligence, describing itself as the premier resource for comprehensive data on the global impact economy and for proprietary research. It says the platform helps teams identify growth markets of the future and the impact markets and new models reshaping that economy. It lists capabilities: sizing an addressable market, quantifying demand, forecasting scenarios at varying rates of growth, and making data driven strategic decisions. It also mentions quantifying impact with rubrics, ratings and scoring, and using impact focused data to power policy, procurement and investment decisions. Further capabilities include helping organisations decide whether to buy, build or partner, and whether to prioritise people, process or technology, framed as accelerating digital transformation by understanding the strategic capabilities required for impact. It says the platform can help find strategic partners, map the partnership landscape and track new alliances, and map a competitive landscape with current and future competitors, synthesising, analysing and visualising for competitive intelligence. HolonIQ states that it powers governments, institutions, technology companies, global firms and investors, and that global media rely on it for insight and data. It invites readers to choose from its newsletters for up to date insights.
sections.heading: What it says

sections.body: The text gives no numbers, dates, market sizes, growth rates or definitions. Its claims are qualitative only: that HolonIQ is the premier resource for comprehensive data on the global impact economy, that it is the world's leading platform for impact market intelligence, and that it serves governments, institutions, technology companies, global firms, investors and journalists.
sections.heading: Figures and claims worth noting

sections.body: A reader following AI in education would find this page useful only as a pointer to a vendor that the industry page cites for tracking the education economy. The harvested text does not mention education, EdTech funding, digital transformation in schools, AI learning platforms, K through 12, higher education or workforce learning, so it cannot support those claims on its own. What it does show is the kind of capability HolonIQ advertises, market sizing, demand quantification, scenario forecasting and competitive mapping, which is the type of analysis a reader might expect from the platform behind the industry page's citation. To use it as evidence, a reader would need HolonIQ's actual research output rather than this homepage.
sections.heading: What it means for AI in Education

sections.body: This is a commercial landing page for a vendor, not a report, dataset or article. It is undated in the harvested text and contains no education or AI specific material. Its tone is promotional, using phrases such as premier resource and world's leading platform, and it offers no methodology, sample, figures or sources. The page describes what the platform claims to do rather than presenting findings, so it is partial and cannot be used to verify any claim about education markets or AI in education.
